name: vibedoctor
description: Code health for your VibeDoctor projects: findings from scans, checks of code you send, and a map of the codebase.

interface.longDescription: VibeDoctor scans your GitHub repositories and websites and keeps a record of each project's code health. Connect it to see a project's scores and open findings, check code for security, dependency, quality and performance issues, explore a map of the codebase (what a function touches, what a change affects, which parts have no tests), and record why a finding is a false positive. It works with the projects in your VibeDoctor account; you sign in once and choose Allow.
capabilities: Read a project's code health and open findings
Check code for security, dependency, quality and performance issues
Map the codebase: modules, callers, change impact, test coverage
Answer questions about the code's structure and health
defaultPrompt: What are the most serious issues in my project?
Check the files I just changed for security problems.
Which parts of my code have no tests?

positive.prompt: What are the most serious issues in my project?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the review project's overall score and its open findings by severity, naming the files with the most serious ones, using only data the tools returned.
Reports a hardcoded secret on line 1 and dynamic code execution (eval) on line 2, each with its severity and a fix.

positive.description: Find modules with the most findings
positive.prompt: Which parts of my project have the most findings?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's modules with their finding counts from the code map, highest first.

positive.prompt: Which parts of my code have no tests?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the test coverage percentage and names untested symbols that also have findings.

positive.prompt: The unprotected API route finding in packages/artifacts-viewer/apps/example/worker/index.ts is a false positive because that file is an example app. Please note that in VibeDoctor.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a note with reason false_positive on that finding and says the finding stays open until the user dismisses it in VibeDoctor.
